```sql
SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS ast_to_turnover_ratio, COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM dev.player_game_stats
WHERE strftime('%Y', game_date) = '2017' AND played = 1 AND turnover > 0
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY ast_to_turnover_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
```
